title: Currents of degree above the ambient dimension vanish
statement: Let P, j ∈ ℕ with P < j, let U ⊆ ℝ^P (= Euclid P) be an arbitrary set and let T ∈ 𝒟_j(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U j: a linear functional on the test j-forms supported in U satisfying the SimonGMT sequential continuity axiom). Then T = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P j : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U j), P < j → T = 0
